{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "lipophilic_surface_transfer",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "long_smiles_hydrophobic",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "ESOL: long SMILES lowered solubility (-11.46, weight 0.574); large nonpolar scaffolds partition into octanol."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "very_long_polar_counter",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_very_long"},
          "weight": -0.25,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis: the length role is low-confidence (0.22); very long chains often carry many polar, ionizable groups."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "short_smiles_low_logd",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Source prior: short SMILES raised solubility (+6.89); small polar fragments stay hydrated and show low logD."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_pi_surface",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Extended aromatic pi surface is poorly hydrated, favoring the octanol phase and raising partition coefficients."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.35,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.6,
      "hypothesis": "Same size inversion as the incumbent but with an explicit very-long penalty and broad-coverage aromatic coverage, so the surrogate is informed early; fails if large target molecules are polar or ionizable."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "flexible_ring_balance_partition",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "ring_rich_hydrophobic_surface",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Ring role had the strongest transfer weight (0.758, effect 9.94); ring carbons add desolvated nonpolar surface."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "branch_flexibility_penalty",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_high"},
          "weight": -0.25,
          "rationale": "Rotatable-bond role (weight 0.758): flexible branched chains expose polar groups and cost conformational entropy on transfer."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "hetero_high_polarity_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "Donor-to-heteroatom role maps to hydrogen bonding; high heteroatom count lowers octanol-water partitioning."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "hetero_low_lipophilic_baseline",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_low"},
          "weight": 0.3,
          "rationale": "Heteroatom-sparse scaffolds are nearly pure hydrocarbon, the classic high-logP end of the chemical space."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.2,
      "prior_scale": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.18,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.015,
      "confidence": 0.55,
      "hypothesis": "Uses the two highest-transfer-weight roles (ring 0.758, branch 0.758) plus heteroatom polarity as the primary drivers, avoiding the low-confidence length role; fails if ring-rich scaffolds in this pool are heavily oxygenated."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "lipophilic_surface_transfer",
  "lesson": "Both prior skills scored within noise on development seeds (86.8 vs 86.5 mean AUC), a spread far smaller than the per-seed variance (79-94); the halogen_high rule rested on only 98 of 4200 molecules, so sparse-bin rules buy no reliable lift. The length inversion and broad-coverage aromatic surface carry the signal, and the uncertain very-long bin is better downweighted than left implicitly positive.",
  "revision_summary": "Kept the deployed length-inversion core because it was the higher-AUC skill and rests on broad bins, sharpened it with an explicit negative very-long rule instead of the sparse halogen rules, and paired it with a distinct second skill built on the two strongest transfer roles (ring 0.758, branch 0.758) plus heteroatom polarity, dropping halogens entirely since halogen_high covers only 98 candidates. Deployment frozen on lipophilic_surface_transfer for coverage and stability."
}
